assurance_case.title: Example collateralized-lending system — synthetic assurance-case cross-walk

subject.name: Example collateralized-lending system (synthetic; no real protocol)

assurance_case.notes: This document exists so schema/validate_refs.py exercises all eight assurance-case gates in CI. It is NOT a case study: the subject is invented, the revisions are placeholders, and the evidence records describe results that were never produced. BPO hosts no real cross-walk, because a cross-walk is an artifact of the verification project that produced the evidence and points up at this catalogue. The eight entries below are chosen to cover every `alignment` value and every `evidence.class` value, including the combinations the gates are designed to reject when they are mislabelled.

assumptions.statement: The account set is finite and bounded by the verification profile; results hold within that bound and are not unbounded claims.
Accounted quantities are drawn from a finite range chosen so that both the healthy and unhealthy regions are reachable.
The settlement asset moves exactly the requested quantity, charges no third-party fee, and does not change balances absent a call from the system.
A failed execution restores the persistent projection to its entry value.

alignments.local_name: Aggregate position total equals the fold of individual positions

bpo_targets.clause: Fold consistency: G_k(m, s) = FOLD over accounts of P_k(m, u, s)
bpo_targets.note: One accounted class only; the backing clause of the same record is not established by this entry.

symbol_bindings.note: Single accounted class in the local model.
Indexed by account within one instance.

covered_clauses: fold consistency for the single accounted class
alignments.residual_scope: Holds within the finite account and quantity bounds of the profile. Says nothing about unbounded account sets, about the backing relation, or about the deployed system.

alignments.local_name: Conversion round trip does not favour the initiating account

bpo_targets.clause: Round trip: RT(d1, d2, q, s) rel_rho q under an unchanged quotation state
bpo_targets.note: Demonstrated on a curated deterministic trace only.

covered_clauses: round-trip direction on the exercised path
uncovered_clauses: the relational clause over all reachable states
alignments.residual_scope: A curated trace shows the direction holds on one path. It is not domain-exhaustive and is not a relational proof; the 2-safety clause of the target record remains open.
alignments.review_caveat: Independent review noted the trace exercises only the protected direction and would not detect an inverted mode selection on the unexercised path.

alignments.local_name: A pending claim is consumed exactly once and never outstanding at a stable boundary

bpo_targets.clause: Exactly-once consumption, and no execution reaches a stable boundary with a claim outstanding
bpo_targets.note: Checked as a temporal product against the claim automaton.

covered_clauses: no outstanding claim at a stable boundary
uncovered_clauses: the frame condition across the untrusted call
the coverage inequality during the interaction phase
alignments.residual_scope: Both antecedent phases are reachable in the profile, so the clause is non-vacuous within its bounds. The frame condition is not encoded and remains open.

evidence.bounds: 195-state callback product, both antecedent phases reachable

alignments.local_name: Exit operations are enabled whenever the declared precondition holds

bpo_targets.clause: Enabledness: Pre implies an exit edge exists
bpo_targets.note: Operation-local constraint checking over enumerated inputs.
Overlaps on the authority conjunct only; neither record covers the other.

covered_clauses: guard admits the enumerated precondition states
uncovered_clauses: which of those states are reachable
alignments.residual_scope: Operation-local checking says nothing about reachability. This is explicitly NOT evidence for BPO:0002 eventual withdrawal, which is a fairness-conditional liveness claim of a different kind.

evidence.bounds: 13 operations, inputs enumerated over the bounded domain

alignments.local_name: State typing and finite bounds hold over the enumerated state space

bpo_targets.clause: Well-formedness of the accounted quantities entering the fold
bpo_targets.note: Static assertion enumeration; overlaps the record's precondition rather than its clause.

covered_clauses: quantities remain within the declared domain over the enumerated states
alignments.residual_scope: An assertion over a state enumeration is not an inductive step, and this entry claims none. It is also explicitly not compiler arithmetic preservation (BPO:0060), which concerns source-to-bytecode translation rather than model-level typing.

evidence.bounds: parse, type and initialisation checks only; the broad graph is not explored

alignments.local_name: A weakened liquidation eligibility guard is detected

bpo_targets.note: Mutation evidence: the guard is being checked by the profile, which is weaker than the guard being correct.

covered_clauses: the profile detects a weakened eligibility guard
alignments.residual_scope: A surviving mutant would show the guard is unchecked; a killed mutant shows only that it is checked, not that it is right.

evidence.bounds: single mutant against the bounded accounting profile

alignments.local_name: The instance time measure is monotone across every operation
uncovered_clauses: monotone instance time as a standalone obligation
alignments.residual_scope: At the pinned baseline no catalogue record carried monotone instance time as its own clause; it appears only as a conjunct inside accrual consistency. Recorded as a gap rather than forced onto an approximate target.

alignments.local_name: An eligible position is eventually liquidated under fair participation
alignments.residual_scope: No run was performed and no catalogue record makes this claim: BPO:0114 is explicit that it asserts no liveness. Recorded as a gap so the absence is visible rather than inferred from silence.
alignments.review_caveat: Independent review flagged that an earlier draft reported this as satisfied by a bounded enabledness run. Enabledness is not liveness; the entry is a gap.
